name: application-stats
title: Stats
description: KPI and metric cards displaying a key value, label, and optional growth indicator for dashboard and analytics summary rows.
useWhen: Summarizing key performance indicators at the top of a dashboard or analytics page.
Showing a primary metric value alongside a delta or trend to communicate whether it is improving.
Displaying a row of four to six comparable metrics in a uniform grid layout.
avoidWhen: The value changes frequently in real time — a stat card without live updates can mislead users.
Detailed breakdown of the metric is needed on the same view — use a table or chart instead.
The page already has too many stat cards — cluster similar KPIs or hide secondary ones behind a toggle.
responsiveBehavior: Stat grids collapse from four columns to two on tablet and a single column on mobile. Each card maintains its padding and typography at all sizes.
accessibility: Use semantic heading levels inside stat cards to establish hierarchy without relying on visual size alone.
Growth indicators that use color (green up / red down) must include an accessible text label or icon label.
Decorative trend icons should carry aria-hidden='true'; the trend text label carries the meaning.

variants.title: Title, value, from value and themed growth stat
variants.description: Stat card showing a headline value, a 'from' previous-period value, and a color-coded growth badge.
accessibility: Growth badge color is supplementary; the delta value text communicates the change to screen readers.

variants.title: Title, value, from value and themed growth stat (Dark)
variants.description: Stat card with previous-value and color-coded growth badge adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Value, label, and growth badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, value, icon and themed growth stat
variants.description: Stat card with a category icon beside the title, a headline value, and a growth badge for quick visual identification.
accessibility: Category icon is decorative when the title already identifies the metric; aria-hidden='true' for the icon.

variants.title: Title, value, icon and themed growth stat (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-and-growth stat card adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Icon, value, and growth badge colors must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, value and themed growth stat
variants.description: Minimal stat card with just a label, value, and growth badge — no icon — for the most compact layout.
accessibility: Growth badge must pair its color with a text label; value and label must be programmatically related.

variants.title: Title, value and themed growth stat (Dark)
variants.description: Minimal label/value/growth stat card adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Label, value, and growth badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, value and icon
variants.description: Stat card with a headline value and a supporting icon but no growth indicator — for absolute metrics without trend context.
accessibility: Icon is decorative; title and value text carry the semantic content for screen readers.

variants.title: Title, value and icon (Dark)
variants.description: No-growth icon-and-value stat card adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Icon and value text must meet contrast requirements on dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, value and themed growth stat, stacked style
variants.description: Stacked stat card where the label, value, and growth badge are arranged vertically for a taller, more prominent layout.
accessibility: Stacked layout does not change the semantic relationships between label, value, and badge.

variants.title: Title, value and themed growth stat, stacked style (Dark)
variants.description: Stacked label/value/growth stat card adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: All text and badge colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, value, icon and themed growth stat, stacked style
variants.description: Full-featured stacked stat card combining a category icon, headline value, label, and growth badge in a vertical arrangement.
accessibility: Icon is decorative; stacked layout still exposes label, value, and badge correctly to assistive technology.

variants.title: Title, value, icon and themed growth stat, stacked style (Dark)
variants.description: Full-featured stacked stat card with icon and growth badge adapted for dark dashboard surfaces.
accessibility: Icon, value, label, and growth badge colors must all meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.
